# PrimeDex

> The most complete online Pokédex on the open web. Browse all 1025 Pokémon with detailed base stats, evolution chains, abilities, moves, type matchups, competitive builds, team builder, side-by-side comparison, and TCG cards. Available in 9 languages, free, fast, and beautifully designed.

## Short Facts
- **Pokémon covered**: 1,025 (Generations I–IX, complete National Dex)
- **Total base stats in database**: 1,025 × 6 = 6,150 stat entries
- **Distinct types**: 18 (Normal, Fire, Water, Electric, Grass, Ice, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Flying, Psychic, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Dragon, Dark, Steel, Fairy)
- **Distinct abilities**: 300+ across all Pokémon
- **Languages supported**: 9 (en, fr, de, es, it, ja, ko, zh, pt)
- **TCG cards indexed**: 25,000+ across all sets
- **Page load (LCP, p75)**: < 2.5s on 4G (Next.js 16 + edge cache)
- **Data freshness**: revalidated every 3600s (1 hour)
- **License**: MIT (code), non-commercial fan project
- **First launched**: January 2024

## Data Sources

- [PokéAPI](https://pokeapi.co) — Pokémon species, base stats, moves, abilities, encounters, evolution chains. REST + GraphQL endpoints.
- [TCGdex](https://www.tcgdex.net) — Pokémon Trading Card Game catalog (cards, sets, rarities, images).
- [PokéAPI GraphQL](https://beta.pokeapi.co/graphql) — Localized species names and flavor text in 9 languages.

## About

PrimeDex is a high-performance, open-source Pokémon dashboard built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TanStack Query. It serves as a comprehensive reference for competitive Pokémon players, TCG collectors, and fans. Not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, or The Pokémon Company.

## Core Features

- Complete Pokédex of all 1025 Pokémon across 9 generations with localized names in 9 languages
- Team Builder with type coverage analysis, shared weakness detection, and synergy scoring
- Side-by-side comparison of up to 3 Pokémon with interactive stat radar charts
- Type Chart with strengths, weaknesses, resistances, and immunities for all 18 types
- Moves database with detailed power, accuracy, PP, and effect information
- Pokémon TCG catalog with set, rarity, type, stage, and HP filters
- "Who's That Pokémon?" quiz with 6 modes: Classic, Silhouette, Stats, Time Attack, Survival, Marathon
- Living Dex Tracker for personal collection management (local storage)
- Search and advanced filtering by generation, type, BST, egg groups, special status

## Page Structure

- **Type**: Single-page application (Next.js 16 App Router with client-side navigation)
- **Breakpoints**: Mobile-first responsive (tailwind breakpoints: sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px, 2xl 1536px)
- **Locale prefix required**: Every route is prefixed with /{lang} where lang ∈ {en, fr, es, de, it, ja, ko, zh, pt}

## Header Navigation (fixed top, z-50)

- Logo link → [home](https://primedex.vercel.app/en)
- Search form: `<form role="search">` with `<input type="search" name="search">` — searches all 1025 Pokémon
- Theme toggle: `<button aria-label="Switch to {mode} mode">` — cycles light/dark/system
- Language selector: `<select aria-label="Language selector">` — 9 options, flags
- Main nav: desktop horizontal links, mobile hamburger (`<button aria-label="Open menu">`) triggers sheet/panel

## Homepage (/en) — Core Interaction Flow

1. Hero section: `<h1>` + search bar + filter controls
2. Filter bar: Buttons for Type (18 types), Generation (gen1–gen9), Region (10 regions)
3. Pokédex grid filled with [Pokémon cards](https://primedex.vercel.app/en/pikachu)
4. Each Pokémon card: `<a href="/en/pokemon/{name}">` containing sprite `<img>`, name, types, National Dex number
5. "Load More" button at bottom triggers infinite scroll
6. "Recently Viewed" section (conditionally rendered when history exists)

## Pokémon Detail Page Sections

Example: [Pikachu](https://primedex.vercel.app/en/pikachu)

- Hero: Sprite image, name, National Dex number, type badges, genus
- Base Stats: Horizontal bar chart (HP, ATK, DEF, SPA, SPD, SPE)
- Type Matchups: 4-column grid (2× weakness, 2× resistance)
- Evolution Chain: Tree/cascade of evolution stages with sprites and conditions
- Abilities: List with descriptions (non-default ones lazy-loaded on click)
- Moves: Filterable table (by type, category, generation) with learn method
- Encounters: Location/condition tables per generation
- TCG Cards: Horizontal scroll of trading cards (if any exist)
- Competitive: EV spread recommendations, held items, ability/tera type suggestions

## Key Interactive Patterns

- **Client-side navigation**: Links use `<a>` tags with Next.js prefetch (no page reload)
- **Theme switching**: Sets `class="dark"` on `<html>`, CSS custom properties adjust — smooth transition on `background-color`
- **Filters**: URL search params updated on filter change (`useRouter.push`); page preserves state on back/forward
- **Infinite scroll**: IntersectionObserver + TanStack Query `useInfiniteQuery` with `getNextPageParam`
- **Caching**: TanStack Query `staleTime: 600000`, `gcTime: 3600000`, `retry: 1`, `refetchOnWindowFocus: false`
- **Persistent state**: Zustand store → IndexedDB via idb-keyval (favorites, team, caught, compare list, view history, settings, filters, TCG collections)

## API Endpoints (consumed server-side)

- `GET https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon-species/{id}` — species data
- `GET https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/{id}` — stats, types, abilities
- `GET https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/evolution-chain/{id}` — evolution data
- `GET https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/move/{id}` — move details
- `POST https://beta.pokeapi.co/graphql/v1beta` — localized names, flavor text
- `GET https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/en/cards?pokemon={name}` — TCG cards
- `GET /api/tcg/sets` — TCG set listing (server proxy)
- Supabase REST via `@supabase/supabase-js` — auth, user collections sync

## Item Identifiers

- Pokémon: `name` (slug, e.g. "pikachu"), `id` (National Dex number 1–1025)
- Types: `normal`, `fire`, `water`, `electric`, `grass`, `ice`, `fighting`, `poison`, `ground`, `flying`, `psychic`, `bug`, `rock`, `ghost`, `dragon`, `dark`, `steel`, `fairy`
- Moves: `name` (slug, e.g. "thunderbolt"), `id` (integer)
- TCG Cards: `id` (string, e.g. "swsh1-1"), TCG Sets: `id` (string, e.g. "swsh1")
- Generations: `gen1` through `gen9`

## Languages

The site is fully localized in 9 languages: [English](https://primedex.vercel.app/en), [French](https://primedex.vercel.app/fr), [German](https://primedex.vercel.app/de), [Spanish](https://primedex.vercel.app/es), [Italian](https://primedex.vercel.app/it), [Japanese](https://primedex.vercel.app/ja), [Korean](https://primedex.vercel.app/ko), [Chinese](https://primedex.vercel.app/zh), and [Portuguese](https://primedex.vercel.app/pt). Each page declares `hreflang` alternates and an `x-default` pointing to `/en`.
